datasets.title: Laboratory, operational, and SCADA datasets for anaerobic co-digestion at the Muscatine, IA Water Resource Recovery Facility
datasets.plant: Municipal water resource recovery facility (5.5 MGD) co-digesting primary sludge, thickened waste activated sludge, trucked high-strength industrial organic waste and FOG in two 485,000-gallon (about 1,836 m3) continuously stirred digesters at 36 C (mesophilic).
datasets.period: LABS-raw: 2020-01-01 to 2023-03-31 daily (1,103 rows; 2021-04-06 to 2021-06-27 removed by the providers). SCADA-raw: 2022-03-18 00:01 to 2023-02-28 20:04 at 1-minute resolution (500,400 rows).
datasets.resolution: Daily lab/operational totals; 1-minute SCADA. Units are US customary (deg F, gallons, MGD, cubic feet per minute); reference conditions for gas volumes are not stated.
datasets.citation: Schroer, H. W. and Just, C. L. (2024). Laboratory, operational, and SCADA datasets for anaerobic co-digestion at the Muscatine, IA Water Resource Recovery Facility. University of Iowa. https://doi.org/10.25820/data.006715. Associated article: Schroer & Just (2023) ACS ES&T Engineering, https://doi.org/10.1021/acsestengg.3c00435.

files.description: Provider README naming the two data files and the SCADA pre-processing applied.

Daily lab and operational data, 25 columns: feed volumes (TWAS, PS, HSW, FOG), digester temperatures and pH, SRT, HSW VS and COD, alkalinity, total VFA, FOS/TAC, plant influent flow and BOD, sludge VS, daily-average biogas flow.
Column names, descriptions, units, types, acceptable ranges and the provider's pre-cleaning steps for LABS-raw.csv.

1-minute SCADA log, 27 columns: digester temperatures, sludge/HSW/RAS/WAS flows, tank levels, digester lid heights, biogas flow to burner and boiler and their sum. Rows are not in chronological order (2023 block precedes 2022).
Column names, descriptions, units, types and acceptable ranges for SCADA-raw.csv.

datasets.title: hunter-schroer/municipal-biogas-forecasting: Muscatine, IA WRRF Biogas Production Forecasting Models (v1.0.0)

licence.name: MIT License (LICENSE file inside the archive; Zenodo lists 'other-open')

datasets.period: Contains LABS-raw.csv (byte-identical to the Iowa Research Online copy), LABS-interpolated.csv and LABS-LAGGED.csv, plus notebooks and scripts for the published multiple-linear-regression, TPOT and MLP forecasting models. The SCADA CSV is not in the archive.
datasets.citation: Schroer, H. W. (2023). hunter-schroer/municipal-biogas-forecasting: v1.0.0. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8360096

files.description: GitHub release archive with the published pre-processing and forecasting code and the daily lab CSVs used in Schroer & Just (2023).

datasets.title: Process monitoring and weather datasets on farm-scale biogas digesters
datasets.publisher: Mendeley Data, 2025-01-30 (funder statement names ILRI / CGIAR Trust Fund)
datasets.plant: Four unheated livestock-manure digesters at an ILRI 'Mazingira' site (two flexible-bag units R1/R2, two fixed-dome units R3/R4); fed about 20 kg manure plus 30 kg water per feeding event; digester temperature 23-28 C in the first rows; volumes not stated in the files.
datasets.period: Process sheets: 2024-01-04 to 2025-01-14 (R1, R2: 306 dated rows; R3, R4: about 260 rows from 2024-03). Weather: 2024-04-21 19:00 to 2024-10-18 12:45 at 5-minute resolution (51,766 records, ATMOS 41 station).
datasets.resolution: Irregular near-daily manual readings (date, time, manure fed, water added, cumulative gas-meter reading, air and digester temperature, pH; TS/ash/VS columns mostly empty); gas-composition sheet with unresolved spreadsheet errors; 5-minute weather.
datasets.citation: Mulat, D. (2025). Process monitoring and weather datasets on farm-scale biogas digesters. Mendeley Data, V1. https://doi.org/10.17632/gk3f363sfg.1

files.description: Zip with two workbooks: 'Farm-scale Biodigester 2024_Performance.xlsx' (10 sheets: R1-R4 process logs, manure and bio-slurry characterisation, gas composition) and 'Mazingira main(z6-02152)-1729245757_weather_data.xlsx' (5-minute weather). SHA-256 matches the value published in the Mendeley Data file record.
